Intro: That rat…was it to warn our local Ratcatcher? I have seen the man before…but yet never once spoke with him. I am ashamed of that fact.
His love…was surprising for this community. He intervened before I could make an irreversible decision. I knew I would not be…successful.
But this hatred…oh, this hatred. It beckons me to an unachievable revenge. I hear it calling still, but…
The Ratcatcher was right…there are still things I can do to help this city. My revenge, he promised, will be done. But next time, not alone.
Success: Thank you, Chef. You have saved me more than you have realized. I will be here whenever you need me.
